component-o.description-s: Keystone micro miniature SMT test point (surface mount), 2.7 x 1.0 x 1.5 mm (L x W x H) phosphor bronze loop, silver plate, tape and reel; pad 3.4 x 1.8 mm (Keystone catalog p.55). A single surface-mount loop for probes, clips and hooks on one face, so a board placed on both faces keeps the other side free; its net is the design's.
